## Featured Project

### [Forecasting and Explaining U.S. Unemployment](projects/capstone/index.qmd)

A machine-learning project that combines six publicly available macroeconomic
datasets to forecast U.S. unemployment 3, 6, and 12 months ahead.

The project includes data ingestion, cleaning, feature engineering, time-based
validation, model comparison, and interpretation of the strongest early-warning
indicators.
